title: 伯恩斯坦分析师：宁在帐篷外看戏，谁能复制黄仁勋的十年远见？
speaker: Stacey Rasgon

segments.en: I'd rather watch the circus from outside the tent at this point. I just can't see anybody stepping in. And especially now, you, you add in the uncertainty of who is the new CEO, and can you even find
segments.zh: 眼下我更愿意在帐篷外看戏。我看不到有人会介入。尤其是现在，新CEO人选的不确定性，而且你能否找到

segments.en: a CEO that can be as visionary as, as Jensen, like again, Jensen, I'm not worried about finding someone to be able to physically run it.
segments.zh: 一位像Jensen那样有远见的CEO？再说，Jensen，我不担心找不到能实际运营的人。

segments.en: But Jensen's the guy that's thinking out five years, 10 years, the reason they're in the position today is as the result of decisions that he made, you know, 10 plus years ago.
segments.zh: 但Jensen是那种思考未来五年、十年的人，他们今天的位置正是他十多年前所做决策的结果。

segments.en: And who can do that in a way that, that he can, I don't, I don't know, right?
segments.zh: 谁能以他能做到的方式做到这一点，我不知道，对吧？

segments.en: So it's, it's, it's too much for me at this point.
segments.zh: 所以目前对我来说这太难了。
